statement: Current meta during Masterclass week is farming Nova Dust on Wind Walker beyond G Mush.
G Mush is probably the best map for Nova Dust farming (he's pretty sure).
Wind Walker Nova Dust farming is the best use of active time this week, better than the Royal Guardian grind, with 11x merit bonus if maxed.
Nova Dust discovering is one of the main ways to raise Nova Dust drop chance.
G Mush is good because multikill affects weakest mobs most and the small map means the reindeer gets exploded quickly.
He generally sees 250 or 300 Nova Dust on his D account.
Nova Dust purchases give AFK gains and an extremely powerful damage multiplier.
Nova Dust damage node took him from about a trillion damage to pushing 100 trillion.
Circle-shaped compass bonuses can be bought with Nova Dust and give 1.17x higher bonuses.
This week accelerates Wind Walker gains so much that it's fine to take a break from Royal Guardian grinding.
He put both Royal Guardians on page farming and has been pushing his cavern four page for extra reads.
Final page requirement of a billion isn't worth chasing since it would take over a week at 60-120 per day.
He puts both Royal Guardians on chapter four rather than chapter five.
No real reason to do chapter five or six; reward is only king XP and a card which he doesn't think is worth it.
He may drop a card of fire on the map and puts the remaining characters on Dreadnought.
He pushes Ship in a Bottle and may swap characters to get Pirate Deckhand within card of fire range to push Chum in Deep to 150.
Cuttlefish is never getting done so no reason not to cardify it.
He cares more about Kelpfish than Glow and isn't sure how much he cares about research XP.
After a world gets updated with new cards thresholds can change so he logged on a Chrono farming character to check; it updated fine.
All characters on this map are set up for EXP; one hit over 1800 and he keeps levels somewhat close to his main.
Going over 1800 isn't needed for legend talents or anything else for him but it's nice to keep levels near main.
Viewer stuck on Sky Doggies with Arcane Cultist; he says the answer is probably fairly simple since few maps remain.
Dropping crystal on the top platform of a map spawns far more skulls for unknown reasons; not usable on Sky Dog.
If you can't do top platform place the crystal in the middle of the map next to a rope and let it farm.
Use the Crazy Concoctions talent: drag on screen to cycle potions and release to toss the one selected; many players forget it.
Purple potion debuff increases damage by roughly 4x or more and may be enough to get past the Sky Doggies barrier.
Confirm the toss landed when the eye icon appears on the mob; eye-marked mobs die before others.
For Royal Egg try top platform tech combined with concoctions tech if possible; may be enough.
Gather all needed mobs at the top then run up and kill them all.
Mini ships is a flat map; concoctions tech should help.
For Emperor use the specific platform he showed earlier plus the same tech.
Cog board revolves around EXP; point all directional cogs at your DK or two DKs.
Point directionals at the AFK Royal Guardian you don't use as the active bonuses don't all apply correctly on active; gap about 300 of roughly 7000.
Yang cogs can hit the left or right character; only matters that directionals target the second one.
Closer range non-Yang cogs should be purple left or right cogs with player construction EXP.
Construction levels outshine anything else because a bubble gives build speed per construction level.
Prioritize EXP over build rate on cogs since build rate trades long-term gains for short-term ones.
With tier 9 or 10 tiny cogs adding a bit of build speed to get things going passively is good while mainly chasing EXP.
Every other slot gets the highest EXP cog available such as yellow topaz; don't care about build or flaggy.
Directionals beat higher raw percent cogs because player construction EXP is multiplicative while bonus construction EXP is additive.
X cogs can go anywhere not in the way; board can be rotated; placement is player's choice.
There is little you can change in settings; Steam is laggy in general and a performance patch came out recently.
Web client runs best of all platforms and is recommended if you're fine with the browser version.
Mini-game meta (darts and hoops) is on web because it's less laggy with no random lag spikes.
Summoning meta is on web client where mobs go out about 50% faster than Steam; use it if stuck on endless.
Shrinking the game client as small as possible while idling helps PC and reduces desync for overtime gains.
Minehead is essentially pure RNG with little to explain; only buy order and click strategy matter.
Numbers matter a lot; grid expansion matters; base damage two and mega damage are good; mighty form and better numbers are strong.
Gun toss is just okay; big hit combos important but not the most important.
Get one point into Boom Blocker; you will never get the second.
Final Run Fury is what the entire minehead meta is based around.
Multiplier tiles are good and worth buying; more multis also worth it.
Triple Crown Hunter is meta defining so boosting odds of finding it is also good.
Legal Cheating Button is good; recommend getting it to three or four.
Additives are unclear and may be bad (an int to get) but he's unsure.
Clutch Overtime and Classic Flags are good; he wishes classic flags were cheaper.
Mega damage two  mighty farmer two and base damage three are too expensive.
Jackpot upgrade is terrible; he spent about a billion on it and it only finds three tiles; record-breaking jackpots buffs it.
New minehead gain from Summer Reading shrine for minehead damage and money plus four research nodes.
Corvin has a minehead optimizer; he just clicks four and hopes; also needs the Equinox nightmare so clicks four there.
Go through all lives to the final life then click cheating button; toss flag on an empty grouping; click until shield breaks.
On final life hope for crown multiplier mechanic; keep clicking for as big a multiplier as possible then swing to beat the minehead.
Most players are at his level or one more since the next minehead is about 11 billion XP and not viable.
No more skill or tech in minehead; that's the whole strategy.
Samurai Guardian is a good map for Death Bringer farming.
Stand at the flag on Samurai Guardian then click gravestone to force mobs to spawn bottom left.
Hold A or left arrow to force DB into the corner so it instantly clears the map; best method for the bone.
On Mini Chiefs place the gravestone on the bottom platform; it doesn't isolate all mobs but keeps them around that area.
Royal Egg: use top platform via the Mini Chiefs portal so eggs spawn top left; the lowest is about the next platform.
Your DB may wander off to hit other mobs; tap A to bring him back.
Not sure of a good spot on Sky Doggies for DB.
Ceramic Spirit: place gravestone on the platform by the rope down low to isolate the area.
Leaf Spirit: probably the platform down low (unsure).
For AC best spot is always the top platform; Guardians is the middle platform.
Eggs and Sky Doggies: somewhere in the middle; Clammy and ceramics: middle of the map near the rope.
Leaf Spirit: middle of map rope.
Mama Troll: unsure; middle of map rope or maybe right; can't do top platform.
Banton Spirit: right in the middle of the map; a pretty good map to farm.
Bamboo Spirits: top platform is good; not the true top but around the rope; good map to farm.
Woodlands: success at the bottom of the rope; not a bad map.
Baby Trolls: still meta for its yellow currency; place right in the middle.
River Spirits is a good map; middle-ish under the rope.
Rice cakes: middle platform left rope; sprout: middle under rope.
World five map has high mob density so good; middle platform or bottom of rope.
Fire Spirits is pretty good; middle rope.
Pergus is okay; Citrine is good (high density flat map) in the middle with no rope; multis also good.
Worst case aim for the middle of the map and a rope on AC; if you can aim for top platform.
Wind Walker has no meta spots; just farm the latest map giving the most dust that you can clear.
Unlike other classes spawns are all over the map and revolve around you killing; ask Jake for Wind Walker.
He will keep farming to burn through remaining masterclass resources and puts his character back at green mushrooms.
